items.en: Unit 1 · Introduction · 13.1 · Where urban studies came from, and what "the urban" is
items.zh: 第一单元 · Introduction · 13.1 · 学科起源与"什么是城市"

items.en: This unit had no assigned journal readings. The lecture slides draw on founding urban theorists to sketch how the discipline emerged and how different schools defined "the urban". Slides: Lectures-20260706/introduction.pdf. Bilingual notes on Simmel, Wirth, Sennett and Ilmonen are in Research-Strategy/Draft-*.md.
items.zh: 这个单元没有布置期刊阅读，讲义里穿插引用了几位城市理论奠基人物，勾勒城市研究这门学科怎么来、"the urban"怎么被不同学派定义。讲义：Lectures-20260706/introduction.pdf。Simmel、Wirth、Sennett、Ilmonen 另有双语课程笔记，在 Research-Strategy/Draft-*.md。

items.en: 0.0 · From the slides — Origins and schools of thought
items.zh: 0.0 · 讲义原文梳理 · 学科起源与几大流派

items.en: Engels (1844): The Condition of the Working-Class in England: the miserable conditions of the industrial city (life expectancy 26 years) prompted the first impulse to study cities, responding through mapping and action, together with an anti-urban bias.
items.zh: Engels (1844)：《英国工人阶级状况》：工业城市的悲惨条件（平均寿命 26 岁）促成最早的城市研究冲动，通过制图和行动回应城市问题，也伴随一种"反城市偏见"（anti-urban bias）。

items.en: Chicago School (from the 1920s): Urban development is driven by competition for space and the choices of individuals; defined the American city as unequal and segregated.
items.zh: 芝加哥学派（1920s 起）：城市发展由空间竞争与个体选择驱动，把美国城市定义为不平等、隔离的。

items.en: 1970s political-economy critique: Competition and individual choice are not characteristics of "the city" but of a specific city, the capitalist city. The Chicago School naturalized the unequal city, which suited the political elite. Spatial inequality comes from the politics of the state and city, the power of landowners and the profit-seeking of developers.
items.zh: 1970 年代政治经济学批评：竞争和个人选择不是"城市"的特征，而是"资本主义城市"的特征；芝加哥学派把不平等的城市"自然化"了，客观上服务于政治精英。空间不平等来自国家与城市的政治、地主的权力、开发商的逐利。

items.en: Los Angeles School: A separate slide listing urban form: fragmented, polycentric, decentralized, multi-ethnic, controlled, fortified.
items.zh: 洛杉矶学派：讲义单独一页，只列城市形态特征：碎片化（fragmented）、多中心（polycentric）、去中心化（decentralized）、多族裔（multi-ethnic）、受控（controlled）、堡垒化（fortified）。

items.en: Weber (1921): The European city as a unique social and political entity: the market, its own laws, autonomy, an association of urban residents. Contrasted with Asian cities.
items.zh: Weber (1921)：欧洲城市是独特的社会政治实体：市场、自身的法律、自治、市民的某种联合体，用以与亚洲城市对照。

items.en: Sassen (1991): Global cities such as New York, London and Tokyo become hubs that manage, coordinate and drive globalization, and are also sites of deep inequality and social transformation.
items.zh: Sassen (1991)：纽约、伦敦、东京等全球城市成为管理、协调、驱动全球化的枢纽，同时也是深刻不平等与社会转型的场所。

items.en: Brenner & Schmid (2021): Planetary urbanism: urbanization is a global process driven by capitalism, neoliberalism and globalization, occurring at urban and rural scales. It is a "terrain of struggle" over land, housing, environmental justice and access to basic services, so the agency of social groups matters.
items.zh: Brenner & Schmid (2021)：星球城市化：城市化是由资本主义、新自由主义、全球化驱动的全球过程，发生在城乡各种尺度上；城市化是围绕土地、住房、环境正义、基本服务准入的"terrain of struggle"，要理解各社会群体的能动性。

items.en: Correction An earlier version attributed the "state, landowners, developers" passage to the Los Angeles School. In the slides these are two separate pages and are now listed separately.
items.zh: 更正早先版本把"国家、地主、开发商"那段 1970 年代批评归给了洛杉矶学派。讲义里两者是分开的两页，现已拆开。

items.en: 0.0b · Beyond the slides — The Los Angeles School and the Chicago model it answers
items.zh: 0.0b · 讲义外补充 · 洛杉矶学派，以及它回应的芝加哥模型

items.en: [Note] The slides list only six words for the Los Angeles School. This section adds background from the literature; it is not slide content. Check the original works before citing.
items.zh: 【说明】讲义对洛杉矶学派只列了六个词。这一节是根据相关文献补充的背景，不是讲义原文，写进论文前请核对原著。

items.en: [Who] In the 1980s–90s a group of scholars working in Los Angeles (UCLA, USC) argued that the Chicago School model no longer fitted, and that Los Angeles showed what the contemporary city looks like. Key works: Edward Soja, Postmodern Geographies (1989); Mike Davis, City of Quartz (1990), especially the chapter "Fortress L.A."; Michael Dear & Steven Flusty, "Postmodern urbanism", Annals of the AAG 88(1) (1998); Michael Dear (ed.), From Chicago to L.A. (2002).
items.zh: 【是谁】1980–90 年代，一批在洛杉矶（UCLA、USC）工作的学者提出：芝加哥学派的城市模型已经不适用，洛杉矶才代表当代城市的样子。代表著作：Edward Soja《Postmodern Geographies》（1989）；Mike Davis《City of Quartz》（1990），尤其是"Fortress L.A."一章；Michael Dear & Steven Flusty《Postmodern urbanism》，Annals of the AAG 88(1)（1998）；Michael Dear（编）《From Chicago to L.A.》（2002）。

items.zh: 图 1　Burgess 同心圆模型（Park, Burgess & McKenzie,《The City》, 1925）示意重绘。Burgess 原图中，芝加哥的湖岸把圆切去一半。

items.en: [Chicago model] Burgess pictured the city growing outward from one centre in rings: the Loop (CBD), a zone in transition where new immigrants and the poor first settle, workers' homes, middle-class residences, and an outer commuter zone. Groups move outward as they rise, through "invasion and succession", an analogy borrowed from plant ecology. This is why the slides say the Chicago School naturalized the unequal city: sorting by income looks like a natural ecological process rather than the result of institutions.
items.zh: 【芝加哥模型】Burgess 设想城市从一个中心向外一圈圈生长：中心商务区（Loop）、新移民和穷人最先落脚的过渡区、工人住宅区、中产住宅区、最外层的通勤区。群体地位上升后就往外搬，即"入侵与演替"（invasion and succession），这是从植物生态学借来的类比。讲义说芝加哥学派把不平等的城市"自然化"了，原因就在这里：按收入分层看起来像自然的生态过程，而不是制度造成的结果。

items.en: Figure 2. A schematic of the Los Angeles School model, drawn from Dear & Flusty's (1998) description: several centres, a patchwork of parcels, freeways, gated enclaves and ethnic enclaves. Illustrative only, not a map of Los Angeles.
items.zh: 图 2　洛杉矶学派模型示意图，根据 Dear & Flusty（1998）的描述绘制：多个中心、拼贴式的地块、高速公路、门禁社区和族裔聚居区。仅为示意，不是洛杉矶的真实地图。

items.en: [Core claim] Los Angeles has no dominant centre. Dear & Flusty argue that the periphery organises the centre, not the other way round; they describe development as "keno capitalism", where parcels on a grid are developed seemingly at random rather than spreading out in rings.
items.zh: 【核心主张】洛杉矶没有主导性的中心。Dear & Flusty 认为是外围在组织中心，而不是中心组织外围；他们把这种开发方式称为"基诺资本主义"（keno capitalism）：网格上的地块像彩票开奖一样看似随机地被开发，而不是一圈圈向外扩散。

items.en: [fragmented] The city is cut into disconnected pieces, socially and administratively. Los Angeles County is made up of many separate municipalities, each governing itself.
items.zh: 【fragmented 碎片化】城市被切成互不相连的小块，社会上、行政上都是。洛杉矶县由许多独立的市组成，各管各的。

items.en: [polycentric] There is not one downtown but several functional centres; business and employment are spread across the region, the "edge city" pattern.
items.zh: 【polycentric 多中心】不止一个市中心，而是多个功能中心，商务区和就业区散布各地，即"边缘城市"（edge city）。

items.en: [decentralized] Development spreads outward and the suburbs no longer depend on the centre; a sprawling city tied together by freeways.
items.zh: 【decentralized 去中心化】发展向外扩散，郊区不再依附市中心，是一座由高速公路连起来的蔓延式城市。

items.en: [multi-ethnic] A city of immigrants in which ethnic enclaves sit side by side, such as Koreatown and Little Tokyo. The Koreatown case in DeVerteuil's typology is here.
items.zh: 【multi-ethnic 多族裔】由移民构成，族裔聚居区并存，如韩国城、小东京。课上 DeVerteuil 类型学里的韩国城案例就在这里。

items.en: [controlled] Space is surveilled and privately governed: homeowners' associations, private security, cameras.
items.zh: 【controlled 受控】空间被监控、被私人化管理：业主协会、私人保安、监控摄像。

items.en: [fortified] People are separated by physical means: gated communities, defensive architecture, privatised "public" space. Mike Davis argued that urban space was increasingly designed to keep unwanted people out.
items.zh: 【fortified 堡垒化】用物理手段把人隔开：门禁社区、防御性建筑、被私有化的"公共"空间。Mike Davis 认为，城市空间越来越被设计成把"不受欢迎的人"挡在外面。

items.en: [vs the 1970s critique] The 1970s political-economy critique asks who causes inequality (the state, landowners, developers, capital); the Los Angeles School describes what the resulting city looks like (fragments, many centres, fortification). They do not contradict each other, and several LA School members, such as Soja and Davis, were themselves Marxist. Read in order, the three slides go: the Chicago School naturalizes inequality → the 1970s critique says institutions produce it → the LA School shows the shape of the city that results.
items.zh: 【和 1970 年代批评的区别】1970 年代政治经济学批评问的是"不平等是谁造成的"（国家、地主、开发商、资本）；洛杉矶学派描述的是"结果城市长成什么样"（碎片、多中心、堡垒化）。两者不矛盾，Soja、Davis 等成员本身也是马克思主义取向。讲义三页按顺序读：芝加哥学派把不平等自然化 → 1970 年代学者指出不平等由制度造成 → 洛杉矶学派描述这种城市最后的空间形态。

items.en: [Criticism] The main criticism of the LA School mirrors its own criticism of Chicago: it treats the features of one city as a universal model of the city.
items.zh: 【主要批评】学界对洛杉矶学派的主要批评，和它批评芝加哥学派的理由一样：把一座城市的特征当成了所有城市的普遍模式。

items.en: [Links to your material] Nanjing (Song et al. 2023): most highly gentrified quarters are gated communities, and the authors' "club-isation" of landscape is a Chinese version of fortified and controlled. Kern (2007): condos turn security into a purchasable commodity, the same logic. Hangzhou: Qianjiang New Town, Binjiang, Future Sci-Tech City and Xiaoshan existing side by side is a ready example of polycentric and decentralized.
items.zh: 【和你手上材料的联系】南京（宋伟轩等 2023）：高度绅士化小区多为封闭社区，作者说的"空间俱乐部化"就是 fortified 和 controlled 的中国版本。Kern（2007）：公寓把"安全"变成可以买的商品，也是同一逻辑。杭州：钱江新城、滨江、未来科技城、萧山并存，是 polycentric 和 decentralized 的现成例子。

items.en: 0.1 · Simmel (1903) — The Metropolis and Mental Life
items.zh: 0.1 · Simmel (1903) · The Metropolis and Mental Life 大都市与精神生活

items.en: Notes: Research-Strategy/Draft-Simmel-1903.md
items.zh: 笔记：Research-Strategy/Draft-Simmel-1903.md

items.en: [Core argument] City life changes people at the psychological level. The pace, density and complexity of the metropolis produce a distinct mental attitude.
items.zh: 【核心论点】城市生活从心理层面深刻改变人：大都市的快节奏、高密度、复杂性塑造出一种独特的心理状态。

items.en: [Key concepts] Rural relationships are few, deep and built over time; metropolitan ones are many, shallow and anonymous, so city dwellers come to place their trust in money and exchange. The blasé attitude: emotional detachment as self-protection against overstimulation.
items.zh: 【关键概念】乡村关系少而深、靠时间积累；大都市关系多而浅、大量匿名，城市居民转而与货币和交换建立信任。Blasé attitude（冷漠态度）：面对过度刺激，以情感疏离作为自我保护。

items.en: 0.2 · Wirth (1938) — Urbanism as a Way of Life
items.zh: 0.2 · Wirth (1938) · Urbanism as a Way of Life 都市主义作为一种生活方式

items.en: Notes: Research-Strategy/Draft-Wirth-1938.md
items.zh: 笔记：Research-Strategy/Draft-Wirth-1938.md

items.en: [Core argument] Three structural variables, size, density and heterogeneity, explain five features of urbanism as a distinct way of life.
items.zh: 【核心论点】用规模、密度、异质性三个结构变量，解释都市主义作为一种独特生活方式的五个特征。

items.en: [Five features] Anonymity and impersonal relationships
items.zh: 【五大特征】匿名性与非个人化关系

items.en: [Five features] Specialization and division of labour (economic interdependence)
items.zh: 【五大特征】专业化与劳动分工（经济互赖）

items.en: [Five features] Cultural diversity (promotes tolerance, may also cause fragmentation and conflict)
items.zh: 【五大特征】文化多样性（促进宽容，也可能导致碎片化和冲突）

items.en: [Five features] Rational, calculated, goal-oriented behaviour (individualism over community ties)
items.zh: 【五大特征】行为理性化、目标导向（以社群纽带换取个人主义）

items.en: [Five features] Weakened social ties
items.zh: 【五大特征】社会纽带弱化

items.en: [vs Simmel] Simmel focuses on psychological mechanism (stimulation → blasé); Wirth on social structure (size + density + heterogeneity → anonymity, division of labour, weak ties). Much Chicago School research builds on accounts like Wirth's.
items.zh: 【与 Simmel】Simmel 偏心理机制（刺激 → blasé），Wirth 偏社会结构（规模 + 密度 + 异质性 → 匿名、分工、纽带弱化）。芝加哥学派的城市研究很大程度建立在这类论述之上。

items.en: 0.3 · Sennett (2018; slides 2019) — Building and Dwelling: Ethics for the City
items.zh: 0.3 · Sennett (2018 / 讲义 2019) · Building and Dwelling: Ethics for the City

items.en: Notes: Research-Strategy/Draft-Sennett-2019.md
items.zh: 笔记：Research-Strategy/Draft-Sennett-2019.md

items.en: [Core argument] There is a tension between building (the physical construction of cities) and dwelling (how people experience and live in them). Better cities balance the technical side of planning with residents' lived experience.
items.zh: 【核心论点】城市的物质建设（building）与人们如何体验和生活其中（dwelling）之间存在张力；更好的城市要平衡规划设计的技术面与居民的真实生活经验。

items.en: [Key definition] A city is "a human settlement in which strangers are likely to meet". Cities should have public spaces where residents acquire urban competence by learning to socialize with strangers.
items.zh: 【关键定义】城市是 "a human settlement in which strangers are likely to meet"。城市应提供公共空间，让居民通过与陌生人交往习得 urban competence（都市能力）。

items.en: 0.5 · An open question from the slides — What is the urban?
items.zh: 0.5 · 讲义留下的开放问题 · What is the urban?

items.en: [Slides] "If you stand naked on the front porch and the neighbours can't see you, it's rural; if they call the cops, it's suburban; if they ignore you, it's urban." This echoes Berndt (2015): cities are less physical entities than a theoretical category for arguing about wider social transformation.
items.zh: 【讲义】"如果你裸体站在门廊上，邻居看不见，那是乡村；邻居报警，那是郊区；邻居毫不在意，那才是城市。"呼应 Berndt (2015)：城市未必是纯粹的物理实体，而是一种用来论证社会整体转型的理论范畴。

items.en: Unit 2 · Housing · 20.1 · Housing: home, commodity or asset
items.zh: 第二单元 · Housing · 20.1 · 住房：家、商品还是资产

items.en: Slides Lectures-20260706/housing.pdf in three parts: what housing is, housing preferences, housing policy. Class task: find at least one policy document related to the readings and introduce it in class.
items.zh: 讲义 Lectures-20260706/housing.pdf 分三部分：住房是什么、住房偏好、住房政策。课堂任务：找至少一份与读物相关的政策文件，在课上介绍。

items.en: 2.0 · Lecture framework — Eight points
items.zh: 2.0 · 讲义框架 · 八个要点

items.en: [① What is housing] A basic need (who should provide it?), a commodity from which to extract wealth, or a way of life?
items.zh: 【① 住房是什么】基本需求（谁该提供？）、榨取财富的商品，还是一种生活方式？

items.en: [① What is housing] "Today there is a conflict between housing as lived, social space and housing as an instrument for profitmaking – a conflict between home and real estate." (Madden & Marcuse 2016, 4)
items.zh: 【① 住房是什么】"Today there is a conflict between housing as lived, social space and housing as an instrument for profitmaking – a conflict between home and real estate."（Madden & Marcuse 2016, 4）

items.en: [② Financialization] Aalbers (2016): the increasing role of financial motives, markets and actors in shaping housing. Christophers (2015) contests the concept; Aalbers (2019) stresses context-specific outcomes. Actors include institutional and international investors, listed and non-listed real-estate investment companies (REITs) and foundations.
items.zh: 【② 金融化】Aalbers (2016)：金融动机、市场与行为者在塑造住房中的作用日益增强。Christophers (2015) 指出概念有争议；Aalbers (2019) 强调结果因语境而异。行为者包括机构投资者、国际投资者、上市与非上市房地产投资公司（REITs）、基金会。

items.en: [② Financialization] "Housing is at the heart of the growing economic divide in Europe and the US." (Clark 2021, 151)
items.zh: 【② 金融化】"Housing is at the heart of the growing economic divide in Europe and the US."（Clark 2021, 151）

items.en: [③ Ilmonen] Housing situation: Housing shortage | "Affordable housing"
items.zh: 【③ Ilmonen】住房状况：住房短缺｜"可负担住房"

items.en: [③ Ilmonen] Household size: Large families | Small households
items.zh: 【③ Ilmonen】家庭规模：大家庭｜小家户

items.en: [③ Ilmonen] Role of housing: Housing as need | Housing as consumption
items.zh: 【③ Ilmonen】住房定位：住房作为需求（need）｜住房作为消费（consumption）

items.en: [③ Ilmonen] Type of need: Quantitative needs | Qualitative needs
items.zh: 【③ Ilmonen】需求性质：量的需求｜质的需求

items.en: [③ Ilmonen] Main group: Working class | Middle class; diversifying residents
items.zh: 【③ Ilmonen】主要人群：工人阶级｜中产阶级，人群日益分化

items.en: [③ Ilmonen] Checked word for word against the slides. Matches the "first / second housing question" framework in Ilmonen's (2016) chapter.
items.zh: 【③ Ilmonen】已逐字核对讲义原文。与 Ilmonen (2016) 章节里"第一住房问题 / 第二住房问题"的框架吻合。

items.en: [④ Finnish tenures] Owner occupation: single-family houses, or the asunto-osakeyhtiö (limited liability housing company: you buy shares that entitle you to use a given flat)
items.zh: 【④ 芬兰权属】自住产权：独栋住宅，或 asunto-osakeyhtiö（有限责任住房公司，购买股份获得特定公寓的使用权）

items.en: [④ Finnish tenures] Right of occupancy (asumisoikeusasunto): pay 15% of the property's value upfront for the right to live there, plus a monthly fee; a hybrid of renting and owning
items.zh: 【④ 芬兰权属】居住权住房（asumisoikeusasunto）：预付房价 15% 换取居住权，另付月费，介于租与买之间

items.en: [④ Finnish tenures] Cooperative housing
items.zh: 【④ 芬兰权属】合作社住房

items.en: [⑤ Rental market] A dualist rental market: private rental plus social (ARA) housing. In private rental, neither rents nor tenant selection are regulated. Ruonavaara (2017, 9) describes ARA housing as "not priced by the market and primarily targeted at low and middle-income households": means-tested, cost-based, subsidized.
items.zh: 【⑤ 租赁市场】二元租赁市场：私人租赁 + 社会住房（ARA）。私人租赁的租金和租客筛选都不受管制。Ruonavaara (2017, 9) 形容 ARA 住房 "not priced by the market and primarily targeted at low and middle-income households"：经济状况审查、成本定价、受补贴。

items.en: [⑥ Housing policy] Finnish Constitution §19: public authorities shall promote everyone's right to housing. Ministry of the Environment (2019): housing policy promotes decent housing for all, sustainable development, the functioning of society and the labour market, and empowerment. Instruments are demand-side subsidies (to households) and supply-side subsidies (to production). 1995–2023 saw a shift from the supply side to the demand side.
items.zh: 【⑥ 住房政策】芬兰宪法第 19 条：公共权力机构要促进每个人的住房权。环境部（2019）：住房政策要促进人人享有体面住房、可持续发展、社会与劳动力市场运转和赋权。工具分需求侧补贴（给家户）和供给侧补贴（补贴生产）；1995–2023 年芬兰从供给侧转向需求侧。

items.en: [⑦ Why so expensive] "We must go beyond just looking at the supply of housing and examine demand, in particular the demand for housing as a financial asset." (Ryan-Collins 2019)
items.zh: 【⑦ 为什么贵】"We must go beyond just looking at the supply of housing and examine demand, in particular the demand for housing as a financial asset."（Ryan-Collins 2019）

items.en: [⑦ Why so expensive] Harvey (1978): wealth flows into real estate rather than productive investment. The lecture's own line: "Housing is not just about homes, it's an asset class."
items.zh: 【⑦ 为什么贵】Harvey (1978)：财富被投入房地产而非生产性投资。讲义自己的表述："Housing is not just about homes, it's an asset class."

items.en: [⑧ What can be done] Regulate lending; treat different tenures equally; develop more social housing; stop developing buy-to-lets.
items.zh: 【⑧ 可以做什么】管制信贷；平等对待不同权属；发展更多社会住房；停止发展 buy-to-let。

items.en: 5 · Ruonavaara (2025) — An idea that refuses to die: Rise, fall and resurgence of "housing class"
items.zh: 5 · Ruonavaara (2025) · An idea that refuses to die: Rise, fall and resurgence of "housing class"

items.en: Housing Studies 40(11), 2507–2527
items.zh: Housing Studies 40(11), 2507–2527

items.en: [Core argument] Traces the intellectual history of "housing class" from Rex & Moore (1967), through Saunders' property class, to the 2020s revival as asset-based class (Adkins et al.).
items.zh: 【核心论点】梳理 housing class 理论从 Rex & Moore (1967)，到 Saunders 的 property class，再到 2020 年代 Adkins 等人 asset class 理论复兴的学术史。

items.en: [Key concepts] Rex & Moore (1967): in Birmingham's Sparkbrook, people's relation to housing (owning, council renting, private renting) forms a "class" independent of relations of production.
items.zh: 【关键概念】Rex & Moore (1967)：伯明翰 Sparkbrook 移民社区；人与住房资源的关系（自住、公租、私租）构成独立于生产关系的"阶级"。

items.en: [Key concepts] Saunders: suppliers of housing capital (developers, landlords, financial institutions), non-owners (tenants, the homeless), and owner-occupiers who accumulate capital gains through inflation, negative real interest rates and tax subsidies.
items.zh: 【关键概念】Saunders：住房资本供给者（开发商、房东、金融机构）、非产权者（租户、无家可归者）、自住业主；后者通过通胀、负实际利率、税收补贴积累资本利得。

items.en: [Key concepts] Piketty: residential property is about half of total capital, and returns on assets persistently outpace wage growth.
items.zh: 【关键概念】Piketty：住宅地产约占总资本一半，资产回报率持续超过工资增长率。

items.en: [Key concepts] Adkins, Cooper & Konings: class turns on whether you own assets that outpace inflation and wages. Five groups: investors, outright owners, mortgaged owners, renters, the homeless.
items.zh: 【关键概念】Adkins, Cooper & Konings：阶级的关键是是否拥有能跑赢通胀和工资的资产。五类：投资者、无贷款自住者、有贷款自住者、租客、无家可归者。

items.en: [Conclusion] Housing class does not hold up as a "class" in theory and is better understood as a Weberian status group. But the effect of housing-wealth inequality on life chances is real and growing.
items.zh: 【结论】作者认为 housing class 作为"阶级"在理论上站不住，更适合理解为韦伯意义上的地位群体（status group）；但住房资产不平等对生活机会的影响是真实且日益加剧的。

items.en: 6 · Hirvonen & Lilius (2019) — Do neighbour relationships still matter?
items.zh: 6 · Hirvonen & Lilius (2019) · Do neighbour relationships still matter?

items.en: The reading list also includes Lilius & Hirvonen (2023), Journal of Housing and the Built Environment 38
items.zh: 阅读清单另列 Lilius & Hirvonen (2023), Journal of Housing and the Built Environment 38

items.en: [Core argument] Compares Finnish national surveys from 1986 and 2012 to trace changes in weak and strong neighbour ties.
items.zh: 【核心论点】对比 1986 年与 2012 年两次芬兰全国问卷，分析邻里弱关系和强关系的变化。

items.en: [Findings] Under-45s have significantly fewer weak and strong ties: a generational decline, not just a life-stage effect
items.zh: 【主要发现】45 岁以下世代的弱关系和强关系都显著减少，是世代性下降，不只是生命阶段效应

items.en: [Findings] Problematic neighbour relations rose slightly, more so among the young
items.zh: 【主要发现】问题性邻里关系略有上升，年轻群体更明显

items.en: [Findings] Degree of urbanization matters little; central Helsinki and rural areas show similar trends
items.zh: 【主要发现】城市化程度影响很弱，赫尔辛基市中心与农村趋势相似

items.en: [Findings] Housing type is not significant once age and length of residence are controlled
items.zh: 【主要发现】控制年龄和居住时长后，住房类型影响不显著

items.en: [Findings] Tenants have fewer weak ties yet want to know neighbours more (46% vs 31% of owners): a "subjective contact gap"
items.zh: 【主要发现】租户的邻里弱联系更少，却更想认识邻居（46% vs 业主 31%），存在"主观邻里接触缺口"

items.en: [Findings] Semi-detached residents chat most, and also report the most problems
items.zh: 【主要发现】联排住宅居民聊天最多，问题性关系也最多

items.en: [Policy] Apartment blocks should provide shared social space; high turnover in rental housing should be curbed; the assumption that urban life necessarily weakens neighbour ties does not hold.
items.zh: 【政策启示】公寓楼应提供公共社交空间；应抑制出租住宅的高流动率；"城市生活必然削弱邻里关系"这一假设不成立。

items.en: 7 · Kern (2007) — Reshaping the Boundaries of Public and Private Life: Gender, Condominium Development, and the Neoliberalization of Urban Living
items.zh: 7 · Kern (2007) · Reshaping the Boundaries of Public and Private Life: Gender, Condominium Development, and the Neoliberalization of Urban Living

items.en: Urban Geography 28(7), 657–681
items.zh: Urban Geography 28(7), 657–681

items.en: [Core argument] Uses Toronto's condo boom to show how new-build gentrification, through condo ownership, reshapes women's sense of the public/private boundary, and how neoliberal governance appropriates "empowerment" talk for a story of consumption and privatization.
items.zh: 【核心论点】以多伦多公寓开发热潮为例，分析新建绅士化如何通过公寓所有权重塑女性对公共与私人边界的认知，以及新自由主义治理如何把"赋权"话语挪用为消费和私有化叙事。

items.en: [Key concepts] Condos are framed as the "natural" answer to sprawl, deindustrialization and housing demand: a depoliticizing neoliberal strategy
items.zh: 【关键概念】公寓开发被包装成解决蔓延、去工业化、住房需求的"自然"方案，是新自由主义的去政治化策略

items.en: [Key concepts] Single women are about 40% of Toronto condo buyers, presented by the media as women's liberation
items.zh: 【关键概念】单身女性约占多伦多公寓购买者 40%，媒体包装为"女性解放"

items.en: [Key concepts] Four themes from interviews with 21 women owners: tenure (individualized, debt-based freedom), security (redefined as a privately purchasable commodity), community (class-homogeneous and exclusive), proximity (consumer citizenship)
items.zh: 【关键概念】21 位女性业主访谈的四个主题：产权（个人化的负债自由）、安全（被重新定义为可购买的私人商品）、社群（阶层同质的排他性）、邻近性（消费导向的公民身份）

items.en: [Key concepts] Draws on Neil Smith's revanchist city: condos as a quieter way for the middle class to "retake" the core
items.zh: 【关键概念】引 Neil Smith 的 revanchist city：公寓开发是中产"夺回"市中心的隐蔽方式

items.en: [Quotable] The "freedom" women owners experience must be read in the context of class privilege; it signals no broad change in gender relations but benefits a socio-economically privileged few.
items.zh: 【可引用】女性业主体验到的"自由"必须放在阶级特权语境下理解，它不代表性别关系的广泛改变，而是让少数特权群体获益。

items.en: 8 · Ronald & Kadi (2017) — The Revival of Private Landlords in Britain's Post-Homeownership Society
items.zh: 8 · Ronald & Kadi (2017) · The Revival of Private Landlords in Britain's Post-Homeownership Society

items.en: New Political Economy 2017(6), 786–803
items.zh: New Political Economy 2017(6), 786–803

items.en: [Core argument] UK homeownership fell from a 71% peak to 63% (2014) while private renting doubled. Alongside "generation rent" came a less visible "generation landlord" of middle-aged, middle-class amateur landlords.
items.zh: 【核心论点】英国自住率从 71% 峰值降到 63%（2014），私人租赁翻倍。与 generation rent 并行的是 generation landlord：大量中年中产的"业余"小房东。

items.en: [Key concepts] Post-homeownership society: ownership has peaked and fallen in the UK, Australia, Ireland, the US, Japan and Korea
items.zh: 【关键概念】后自住社会：英、澳、爱、美、日韩等国自住率见顶回落

items.en: [Key concepts] Buy-to-let mortgages (introduced 1996) were the key financial tool; BTL investment rose after 2008
items.zh: 【关键概念】Buy-to-Let 按揭（1996 年推出）是关键金融工具，2008 年后 BTL 投资不降反升

items.en: [Key concepts] Landlords grew from about 560,000 (1991) to over 2.1 million (2012); about 89% are individuals or couples and about 78% let one property
items.zh: 【关键概念】房东从 1991 年约 56 万增至 2012 年逾 210 万；约 89% 是个人或夫妻，约 78% 只出租一套

items.en: [Key concepts] The 40–60 cohort converts equity built up in their own homes into second homes to let, as a pension substitute: property-based welfare
items.zh: 【关键概念】40–60 岁世代把自住房积累的权益转为购买第二套房出租，作为替代养老金：property-based welfare

items.en: [Key concepts] Housing inheritance also drives multiple ownership
items.zh: 【关键概念】住房继承也推动多套持有

items.en: [Significance] An evolving asset-based welfare regime: as state pensions shrink, people rely on property for retirement, deepening intergenerational inequality.
items.zh: 【意义】资产型福利体制的演化：国家养老金收缩后，人们依赖私有房产作退休保障，加剧代际不平等。

items.en: 9 · Paadam et al. / Ilmonen (2016) — Ways of Residing in Transformation (edited volume)
items.zh: 9 · Paadam et al. / Ilmonen (2016) · Ways of Residing in Transformation （章节合集）

items.en: Ilmonen chapter: On Housing Preferences and Housing Choices, pp. 35–56, Ashgate
items.zh: Ilmonen 章：On Housing Preferences and Housing Choices, pp. 35–56, Ashgate

items.en: [Chapter 1] Replaces "housing" with ways of residing: residing as a subjectively constructed, dynamic socio-spatial practice. Uses Kemeny's three levels (household, dwelling, residence) and Bourdieu's habitus. Cases include industrial-heritage conversion in Tallinn, senior co-housing in London, gated communities in Bulgaria, standardized housing production in Finland and the UK, and Reykjavík's post-bubble "ghost suburbs".
items.zh: 【第 1 章】用 ways of residing 取代传统 housing 概念，强调居住是主观建构、动态的社会空间实践。借 Kemeny 的居住社会学三层（住户、住宅、居所）和 Bourdieu 的 habitus。案例包括塔林工业遗产改造、伦敦老年合作居住、保加利亚门禁社区、芬兰和英国住房生产标准化、雷克雅未克泡沫后的"幽灵郊区"。

items.en: [Chapter 3 Ilmonen] The "first housing question" (shortage, poverty) vs the "second housing question" (housing shifts from need to consumption, carrying identity and lifestyle)
items.zh: 【第 3 章 Ilmonen】"第一住房问题"（短缺、贫困）与"第二住房问题"（住房从需求变为消费，承载身份与生活方式）

items.en: [Chapter 3 Ilmonen] Stated vs revealed preferences: what people say they want often differs from what they buy
items.zh: 【第 3 章 Ilmonen】stated preferences vs revealed preferences：说想要的和实际买的经常不同

items.en: [Chapter 3 Ilmonen] Via Bourdieu and Giddens: housing choice is a "narrative of self-identity", shaped by economic resources and cultural capital
items.zh: 【第 3 章 Ilmonen】借 Bourdieu 与 Giddens：住房选择是一种"自我认同的叙事"，受经济资源与文化资本共同塑造

items.en: [Chapter 3 Ilmonen] Research gap: most work asks what people want, little asks why
items.zh: 【第 3 章 Ilmonen】研究空白：多数研究关注人们想要什么，很少关注为什么

items.en: [Chapter 3 Ilmonen] Singleton society: the EU share of one-person households is projected to rise from 30% (2015) to 36%
items.zh: 【第 3 章 Ilmonen】单人户社会：欧盟单人户比例预计从 2015 年 30% 升至 36%

items.en: Slides: Lectures-20260706/Segregation_270126.pdf
items.zh: 讲义：Lectures-20260706/Segregation_270126.pdf

items.en: [Definitions] Neutral: Massey & Denton (1988) "the degree to which two or more groups live separately from one another"; Andersson & Turner (2014) the unequal representation of groups across space.
items.zh: 【定义】中性：Massey & Denton (1988) "the degree to which two or more groups live separately from one another"；Andersson & Turner (2014) 各类群体在空间上的不均等分布。

items.en: [Definitions] Detrimental: Marcuse (2005, 16) a group treated as inferior is forced, involuntarily, to cluster in a defined area; Tammaru et al. (2021) "Advantage breeds advantage and disadvantage breeds disadvantage."
items.zh: 【定义】有害：Marcuse (2005, 16) 被视为低等的群体非自愿地聚集在某一空间；Tammaru et al. (2021) "Advantage breeds advantage and disadvantage breeds disadvantage."

items.en: [Definitions] The slides flag one pair of terms: 'segregation' vs 'spatial differentiation'.
items.zh: 【定义】讲义特别列出一组术语：'Segregation' vs 'spatial differentiation'。

items.en: [Measurement] Dissimilarity index (Finnish regions 2022; Finnish cities 2000–2018); Gini coefficient and low-income rate (natives vs residents with foreign background, 1995–2024).
items.zh: 【测量】Dissimilarity index（芬兰各地区 2022、芬兰城市 2000–2018）；基尼系数与低收入率（本地人 vs 外国背景居民，1995–2024）。

items.en: [Wicked problem] Rittel & Webber (1973): complex, interconnected, affecting many stakeholders, persistent and ever-morphing; it cannot be reduced to a problem–solution frame.
items.zh: 【棘手问题】Rittel & Webber (1973) 的 wicked problem：复杂、相互交织、涉及多方、长期存在且不断变形，无法化约为"问题—方案"。

items.en: [Vicious circle] Tammaru et al. (2021): people are sorted into activity sites by buying or renting a home, starting school or taking a job, then experience contextual effects there. Five steps:
items.zh: 【恶性循环】Tammaru et al. (2021)：人们通过买房、租房、入学、就业被分选进具体场所，再在那里承受情境效应。五个环节：

items.en: [Vicious circle] Disadvantage clusters spatially (concentrated social housing, lack of affordable market housing)
items.zh: 【恶性循环】劣势在空间上聚集（社会住房集中、缺乏可负担的市场住房）

items.en: [Vicious circle] Neighbourhood effects: objective (services, education) and subjective (perceived upkeep)
items.zh: 【恶性循环】邻里效应：客观（服务、教育）与主观（对维护状况的感知）

items.en: [Vicious circle] Selective mobility: fear of negative effects shapes moving preferences
items.zh: 【恶性循环】选择性迁移：对负面邻里效应的担忧影响迁居偏好

items.en: [Vicious circle] Spread to other life domains (van Ham & Tammaru 2016): schools, workplaces, travel
items.zh: 【恶性循环】扩展到其他生活领域（van Ham & Tammaru 2016）：学校、工作场所、通勤

items.en: [Vicious circle] Persistence across the life course and generations; management grows harder
items.zh: 【恶性循环】跨生命历程、跨代际延续，管理越来越难

items.en: [Managing it] Neighbourhood effects, area-based interventions, social mixing, providing spatial justice, equalizing structural inequalities.
items.zh: 【管理路径】neighborhood effects、area-based interventions、social mixing、providing spatial justice、equalizing structural inequalities。

items.en: [Finland] From afar: low segregation by European and Nordic standards, no negative neighbourhood effects; small-scale social mixing in Helsinki since the 1970s, resting on a large social housing sector.
items.zh: 【芬兰】远看：隔离水平在欧洲和北欧都偏低，缺乏负面邻里效应；赫尔辛基自 1970 年代起实行小尺度社会混合，依托庞大的社会住房部门。

items.en: [Finland] Up close: in the era of market-oriented housing production, segregation has risen across Europe, Finland included; in Finland's largest cities it has grown steadily, challenging the welfare-state ethos.
items.zh: 【芬兰】近看：市场导向的住房生产时代，包括芬兰在内的欧洲国家隔离上升；芬兰最大城市的隔离近几十年持续增长，挑战福利国家理念。

items.en: [Finland] From proactive housing policy to reactive social policy: area-based initiatives spread nationwide in the 1990s; supply-side subsidies gave way to demand-side ones; in the 2010s the social housing stock declined and private renting grew, criticized as accelerating financialization; municipalities cannot influence tenant selection in market housing.
items.zh: 【芬兰】从主动住房政策转向被动社会政策：1990 年代区域干预全国推广；供给侧补贴被需求侧取代；2010 年代社会住房存量下降、私人租赁增长，被批评加速了金融化；市政府无法影响市场化住房的租客选择。

items.en: [Finland] A retrenching regime: since 2024 housing benefits have been cut along with other social security; retrenchment began in the 1980s; Kynsilehto & Alastalo (2024) call it a " post-welfare state ", with segregation delegated to local levels and responsibility for housing markets increasingly shared with the private sector.
items.zh: 【芬兰】收缩中的住房体制：2024 年起住房补贴随其他社保一起削减；收缩始于 1980 年代；Kynsilehto & Alastalo (2024) 称之为"post-welfare state"，隔离等社会问题被下放到地方，住房市场的责任越来越多地与私人部门分担。

items.en: 1 · Shaw (2008) — Gentrification: What It Is, Why It Is, and What Can Be Done about It
items.zh: 1 · Shaw (2008) · Gentrification: What It Is, Why It Is, and What Can Be Done about It

items.en: [Core argument] Gentrification is a continuum of social and economic geographic change, from outright disinvestment to super-gentrification. There is no need to assume every neighbourhood passes through every stage.
items.zh: 【核心论点】绅士化是一个社会与经济地理变化的连续谱，从彻底撤资到 super-gentrification，不必预设所有社区都走完阶段模型。

items.en: [Key concepts] Ruth Glass (1964) coined the term for the "gentry" moving into working-class London and renovating old houses
items.zh: 【关键概念】Ruth Glass (1964) 首创这个词，指"绅士"涌入伦敦工人阶级社区、买下并翻新老房子

items.en: [Key concepts] Neil Smith stresses its class character: working-class neighbourhoods "rehabilitated" by middle-class buyers, landlords and developers
items.zh: 【关键概念】Neil Smith 强调阶级性质：工人阶级社区被中产购房者、房东和开发商"修复"

items.en: [Key concepts] Rent gap: when the gap between capitalized and potential ground rent is wide enough, redevelopment pays and the area is "ripe"
items.zh: 【关键概念】Rent gap：当前资本化地租与潜在地租的差距足够大时，开发有利可图，社区"成熟"到可以被绅士化

items.en: [Key concepts] Three waves (Hackworth & Smith 2001): sporadic and state-funded → market-driven and resisted → corporate capital with systemic state involvement; Lees et al. propose a fourth wave (financialization + pro-gentrification policy)
items.zh: 【关键概念】三波绅士化（Hackworth & Smith 2001）：零星、政府资助 → 市场驱动、伴随抵抗 → 大资本主导、国家系统性介入；Lees et al. 提出第四波（金融化 + 亲绅士化政策）

items.en: [Key concepts] The displacement debate: Tom Slater argues that gentrification research has itself been gentrified, no longer attending to displacement
items.zh: 【关键概念】置换争议：Tom Slater 批评"绅士化研究本身已经被绅士化"，研究者不再关注置换

items.en: [Policy] Gentrification advances fastest where new investment is least needed. The best time to intervene is before the rent gap fully opens, when protecting low-income areas and investing in public facilities is most feasible economically and politically.
items.zh: 【政策启示】绅士化在最不需要新投资的地方推进最快；介入的最佳时机是租差尚未完全打开之前，此时保护低收入社区、投资公共设施在经济和政治上都最可行。

items.en: 2 · Davidson (2018) — New-build gentrification (Handbook of Gentrification Studies, ch. 15)
items.zh: 2 · Davidson (2018) · New-build gentrification （绅士化研究手册第 15 章）

items.en: [Core argument] New-build gentrification (new condo towers, waterfront developments) has become the dominant form of third-wave gentrification, often actively backed by the state: state-led gentrification.
items.zh: 【核心论点】新建绅士化（新建公寓塔楼、滨水开发）已成为第三波绅士化的主导形式，常有国家积极支持，即 state-led gentrification。

items.en: [Key concepts] Davidson & Lees (2005), four elements: reinvestment of capital, social upgrading, landscape change, direct or indirect displacement
items.zh: 【关键概念】Davidson & Lees (2005) 四要素：资本再投资、社会阶层升级、景观变化、直接或间接置换

items.en: [Key concepts] The residentialization debate: Lambert & Boddy argue new-build without direct displacement is not gentrification; Davidson & Lees reply with indirect displacement (the area becomes unaffordable, existing shops and services disappear)
items.zh: 【关键概念】Residentialization 之争：Lambert & Boddy 认为没有直接置换就不算绅士化；Davidson & Lees 以间接置换反驳（社区变得难以负担、原有商店服务消失）

items.en: [Key concepts] Reurbanization: a European term for population returning to the core that sidesteps class displacement; the author argues it hides the class dimension
items.zh: 【关键概念】Reurbanization：欧洲学者用来描述人口回流市中心、回避阶级置换的说法，作者认为它掩盖了阶级维度

items.en: [Key concepts] Global new-build gentrification takes different state–capital forms in China (state-led, large-scale demolition), the UK, Sweden, the Philippines and elsewhere
items.zh: 【关键概念】全球新建绅士化：中国（国家主导、大规模拆迁）、英国、瑞典、菲律宾等地的国家与资本关系各不相同

items.en: [Quotable] "gentrification without displacement is not gentrification". Indirect displacement and the pressure created by social-mix policy are often overlooked.
items.zh: 【可引用】"gentrification without displacement is not gentrification"。但间接置换、social mix 政策造成的驱逐压力常被忽视。

items.en: 3 · DeVerteuil (2018) — Immigration and gentrification (same handbook, ch. 25)
items.zh: 3 · DeVerteuil (2018) · Immigration and gentrification （同一手册第 25 章）

items.en: [Core argument] The relationship between immigration and gentrification has long been neglected and is more complex than "immigrants get displaced". Five types:
items.zh: 【核心论点】移民与绅士化的关系长期被忽视，远比"移民被驱逐"复杂。提出五类关系：

items.en: [Five types] Immigrants as a barrier to gentrification (Goutte d'Or, Paris)
items.zh: 【五种类型】移民作为绅士化的屏障（巴黎 Goutte d'Or）

items.en: [Five types] Immigrants and gentrifiers coexisting (bubble model, Stoke Newington, London)
items.zh: 【五种类型】移民与绅士化者并存（bubble model，伦敦 Stoke Newington）

items.en: [Five types] Immigrants displaced (the classic case, Chinatowns)
items.zh: 【五种类型】移民被驱逐（经典案例，唐人街）

items.en: [Five types] Immigrants avoiding gentrified areas (Chinese households moving to Vancouver's suburbs)
items.zh: 【五种类型】移民主动回避已绅士化地区（温哥华华人迁往郊区）

items.en: [Five types] Immigrants as gentrifiers (Koreatown, Los Angeles: immigrant entrepreneurs reinvesting in their own enclave)
items.zh: 【五种类型】移民本身成为绅士化者（洛杉矶韩国城，移民企业家再投资族裔飞地）

items.en: 4 · Lees (2008) — Gentrification and Social Mixing: Towards an Inclusive Urban Renaissance?
items.zh: 4 · Lees (2008) · Gentrification and Social Mixing: Towards an Inclusive Urban Renaissance?

items.en: [Core argument] Governments in the UK, US and Netherlands present social-mix policy as the positive face of gentrification: moving middle-class residents into poor areas to reduce segregation and build "community capital". The evidence does not support this logic.
items.zh: 【核心论点】英、美、荷政府把 social mix 政策当作绅士化的正面包装：把中产搬进贫困社区以减少隔离、提升"社区资本"。证据显示这套逻辑站不住。

items.en: [Six critiques] Gentrification produces displacement, segregation and polarization, not integration
items.zh: 【六大批判】绅士化造成置换、隔离、两极化，而不是融合

items.en: [Six critiques] Gentrifiers do not really interact with low-income residents; their daily paths rarely cross
items.zh: 【六大批判】绅士化者并不真正与低收入居民交往，生活轨迹几乎不交叉

items.en: [Six critiques] Social mix is one-way: affluent areas are never asked to take in the poor
items.zh: 【六大批判】social mix 是单向策略，从不要求富裕社区接纳穷人

items.en: [Six critiques] It destroys the mutual-support networks that clustering itself provides
items.zh: 【六大批判】它摧毁了贫困聚居本身带来的互助网络

items.en: [Six critiques] Policy never says how much mix is enough
items.zh: 【六大批判】政策从未说清多少混合才算够

items.en: [Six critiques] Policy never explains how mixing happens; putting people side by side does not produce it
items.zh: 【六大批判】政策从未说明混合如何实现，把人放在一起不会自动产生混合

items.en: [Quotable] "gentrification is part of an aggressive, revanchist ideology designed to retake the inner city for the middle classes" (citing Neil Smith)
items.zh: 【可引用】"gentrification is part of an aggressive, revanchist ideology designed to retake the inner city for the middle classes"（引 Neil Smith）

items.en: 5 · Yrjänä (2026) — By any means necessary: the anti-segregation efforts and state-led gentrification in Helsinki
items.zh: 5 · Yrjänä (2026) · By any means necessary: the anti-segregation efforts and state-led gentrification in Helsinki

items.en: [Core argument] Helsinki's social-mix policy, pursued in the name of anti-segregation, amounts to state-led gentrification: a depoliticized, morally justified statistical discourse legitimizes the state's push for market dominance in housing and land.
items.zh: 【核心论点】赫尔辛基以"反隔离"为名推行的 social mix 政策，实质是国家主导绅士化：用一套去政治化、道德正当的统计话语，为国家在住房和土地市场里加强市场支配提供合法性。

items.en: [Case] Stigmatized eastern suburbs Mellunkylä and Meri-Rastila. The 2020 "new urban renewal model" targets four suburban renewal areas, aiming to deconcentrate disadvantaged and ethnic-minority groups and raise owner-occupation and the social-rental share.
items.zh: 【案例】赫尔辛基东部被污名化的外围社区 Mellunkylä 和 Meri-Rastila。2020 年启动"新城市更新模式"，聚焦 4 个外围更新区，目标是分散弱势群体与族裔少数群体、提高自住率与社会租赁份额。

items.en: [Theoretical tools] Reputational gap (Kallin 2017): the distance between a place's imagined potential and its stigmatized present; the wider the gap, the more justified intervention appears
items.zh: 【理论工具】声誉差距（reputational gap，Kallin 2017）：地方被想象的潜力与被污名化的现状之间的差距，差距越大，干预越显得正当

items.en: [Theoretical tools] Subsidy gap (Gray & Kallin 2023): the state first absorbs the costs of land assembly and acquisition to de-risk private capital
items.zh: 【理论工具】补贴差距（subsidy gap，Gray & Kallin 2023）：国家先垫付土地整备、征收等成本，为私人资本去风险

items.en: [Theoretical tools] Social mix as corrective: decontextualized statistics frame the area as a "problem", justifying demolition and densification
items.zh: 【理论工具】social mix 作为矫正措施：用去语境化的统计描述把社区塑造成"问题"，为拆除和加密提供正当性

items.en: [Theoretical tools] False choice urbanism (Slater 2014): the only alternative to gentrification is continued decline
items.zh: 【理论工具】虚假选择城市主义（false choice urbanism，Slater 2014）：除了绅士化只剩持续衰败

items.en: [Theoretical tools] Green gentrification (Wallin 2021): upgrading parks and public space to attract investment. A planner: "If you think about it cynically, building this park is partly about raising the image of the area"
items.zh: 【理论工具】绿色绅士化（Wallin 2021）：翻新公园和公共空间吸引投资。规划官员原话："如果你从犬儒角度想，建这个公园某种程度上就是为了提升这片区域的形象"

items.en: [Theoretical tools] Managed decline (Watt 2023): deliberate under-maintenance in anticipation of demolition
items.zh: 【理论工具】管理式衰败（managed decline，Watt 2023）：拆除预期下故意不维护

items.en: [Theoretical tools] Socializing risk, privatizing profit (Risager 2022)
items.zh: 【理论工具】社会化风险、私有化利润（Risager 2022）

items.en: [Fieldwork] 2024–2025: repairs stalled while rents rose (+8.4% in 2024, +5.3% in 2025); older residents worried about heating and snow clearing; families unable to plan schooling around uncertain demolition timelines; residents learned of demolition from the local paper; the "right to return" does not guarantee the original flat; the Kontula shopping-centre renewal deadlocked for 20 years, with developer NCC withdrawing in March 2025.
items.zh: 【田野证据】2024–2025 年调研：维修停滞但租金照涨（2024 年 +8.4%，2025 年 +5.3%）；老人担心暖气和清雪；家庭因拆迁时间线不确定无法规划孩子上学；居民从本地报纸得知自家楼要拆；"重返权"不保证原公寓；Kontula 购物中心更新僵局 20 年，开发商 NCC 2025 年 3 月退出。

items.en: [Conclusion] Helsinki wants both deeper private dominance of the housing market and the prevention of segregation, and manages the contradiction through gentrification disguised as anti-segregation discourse (Lees 2008). The author suggests treating access to affordable housing as a normal need rather than a social-policy problem; with its planning monopoly and extensive land ownership, Helsinki could prioritize state-subsidized rental housing.
items.zh: 【结论】赫尔辛基既想深化住房市场的私人主导，又想预防隔离，于是采用了"伪装成反隔离话语的绅士化"（Lees 2008）。作者建议把获得可负担住房当作正常需求而非社会政策问题；赫尔辛基有规划垄断权和大量土地所有权，完全有能力优先发展国家补贴租赁住房。

items.en: Gentrification × Housing — Kern's condo privatization and Davidson's new-build gentrification speak to each other: condo development is both the spatial vehicle of gentrification and the material base of asset-based welfare (Ronald & Kadi).
items.zh: Gentrification × Housing　Kern 的公寓私有化与 Davidson 的新建绅士化直接呼应：公寓开发既是绅士化的空间载体，也是资产型福利的物质基础（Ronald & Kadi）。

items.en: Housing class × Gentrification — Ruonavaara's asset-class account explains who profits from gentrification (owners) and who is excluded: the real beneficiaries of the social-mix policy Lees criticizes.
items.zh: Housing class × Gentrification　Ruonavaara 的资产阶级理论可以解释谁能从绅士化中获利（有产者）、谁被排除，即 Lees 批判的 social mix 政策的实际受益者。

items.en: Neighbour relations × Gentrification — Hirvonen & Lilius find tenants have weaker ties but want to know neighbours more, echoing DeVerteuil and Lees on new and old residents whose paths never cross. Useful for the missing social integration in new-build apartment areas.
items.zh: 邻里关系 × 绅士化　Hirvonen & Lilius 发现租户邻里联系更弱、更想认识邻居，与 DeVerteuil、Lees 讨论的"新老居民生活轨迹不交叉"呼应，可用于分析新建公寓社区的社会融合缺失。

items.en: Finnish angle — Hirvonen & Lilius and both Ruonavaara pieces are Finnish studies, good "local" evidence to set against international frameworks (DeVerteuil, Lees, Kern), answering the class question: does Finland have gentrification?
items.zh: 芬兰切入点　Hirvonen & Lilius、Ruonavaara 都是芬兰语境研究，适合作为"本地化"证据，与 DeVerteuil、Lees、Kern 等国际框架对话，回应课堂问题：芬兰是否存在绅士化？

items.en: Segregation × Gentrification New — Social mixing is one of the lecture's tools for managing segregation, and Lees (2008) and Yrjänä (2026) critique exactly how social mixing is used to package gentrification. These two readings bridge the units.
items.zh: Segregation × Gentrification 本版新增　讲义的管理路径里有 social mixing，而 Lees (2008) 和 Yrjänä (2026) 正是在批判 social mixing 被用来包装绅士化。这两篇是两个单元之间的桥。

items.en: Housing × Segregation New — Both lectures record Finland's shift from supply-side to demand-side subsidies. The Housing lecture treats it as a change in policy instruments; the Segregation lecture links it to shrinking social housing, harder mixing and faster financialization.
items.zh: Housing × Segregation 本版新增　两份讲义都记录了芬兰补贴从供给侧转向需求侧。Housing 讲义把它当作政策工具变化，Segregation 讲义把它和社会住房减少、混合变难、金融化加速连在一起。
